counting_bases.note: award_count / unique_awards = distinct awards in the warehouse profile. Summing per-FY award counts double-counts awards with actions in multiple years. recent_* rows are obligation actions (often modifications), not unique awards.

set_aside.note_excerpt: Historical set-aside codes observed on warehouse award actions. last_observed_action_fy is the latest action FY for that code (may be a deobligation). first_observed_positive_action_fy is the earliest positive-obligation action FY when present — a later positive modification is s
